New features
• A-B Loop: a new overlay button to loop a part of the video between two points (#96)
• Set the start and end points from the button menu; the menu shows their times

• Fixed empty intro segments from TheIntroDB marking the whole episode as an intro. IntroDB is now used as a fallback in that case
